["In a large pot over medium heat, combine water, bouillon, potatoes and garlic. Bring to a boil, then stir in onion, celery and carrots. Pour this mixture into the large soup pot, stir well and heat through."]

["Combine beef, potatoes, onion, peppers, and garlic in a large bowl. In a small bowl, mix together the flour, chili powder, cumin, and salt. ["Place salt cod into a bowl and cover with cold water. ["Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil; cook rotini in boiling water until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Add some filling to center of pancake; roll to enclose filling. Transfer to another plate; top with blueberry sauce. Repeat with the remaining batter, filling, and sauce."]

["Add flour, milk, eggs, and salt to a blender. ["Set chicken breast onto a cutting board and make 5 or 6 shallow cuts through the skin. ["Stir together mustard and honey in a small bowl and set aside. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. ["Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook chicken breasts in the oil until nicely browned on the outside.
